## Visual explainers (visualize-anything)

When asked to visualize how something works, animate a flow, make a step-by-step or playable
sequence diagram, explain something visually, or build an interactive explainer, use the
`visualize-anything` skill: read `.agents/skills/visualize-anything/SKILL.md` and follow it exactly.
It has you write the subject as a JSON spec, validate it, and build one self-contained HTML file
with the bundled player. Do not write a custom renderer. Do not use it for charts of numeric data
or for static diagrams with no sequence of steps.
